skipped_smoke_tests.name: Smoke Tests -- Human Visual Verification
skipped_smoke_tests.description:
Test A: Attachment Bar Rendering — Open chat, click paperclip, browse image, verify 48x48 thumbnail + filename + [x] button, verify Lucide icon (not mojibake), click [x] removes attachment, drag PDF shows file-text icon + filename, spinner appears while loading.

Test B: Image Paste (No Freeze) — Copy image to clipboard, Ctrl+V in chat input, verify attachment appears within 1-2 seconds with no freeze, verify thumbnail at constrained size.

Test C: Sent Message Attachments — Send message with image, verify bubble shows thumbnail (max 300px) with filename/size/[x] delete, click thumbnail opens overlay (dark backdrop, centered), click outside or ESC closes overlay, send PDF with text, verify file badge with filename/size/expandable 'Extracted text' preview, click [x] deletes attachment.

Test D: Broken Characters Fixed — Add PDF to composer, verify file badge is proper Lucide icon (not '?' or broken glyphs), send message, verify file icon in bubble is also proper Lucide icon.
skipped_smoke_tests.qa_notes: QA passed: Tests A, B, D pass. Test C mostly passes; one cosmetic defect noted — after clicking delete on a sent attachment (step C8), the thread may scroll to top instead of maintaining position. This is a pre-existing scroll-restore issue in updateChatMessages() unrelated to attachment changes. Also verified escHtml was initially a no-op due to tool entity-decoding bug; fix was re-applied via Node script. Final verification: escHtml correctly escapes &, <, >, ". All 240 tests pass.
